description:
FILED s521 (Fable, 2026-10-18 21:1x) from the round's whole-table bench (review/bench-s521.log, `perl tools/bench-exec.pl`, best-of-5, heavy.sh bench mode at load ~1.1; compared row by row with review/bench-merged-26.log's pclB column by review/bench-compare.pl -> review/bench-s521.compare.txt).  Between the two runs: MAIN-READY-27..36 (ten merges: s518d, s518e, s519a, s519b, s520a, s520b, s521a, s521b, s521c, s521d), and a quieter box (the -26 run was at load ~3).

SLOWER (> 8 %): arrhash-k 1.10x (0.0652 -> 0.0716 s); cfor 1.09x (0.0186 -> 0.0203 s); gcdret 1.17x (0.0706 -> 0.0829 s); intloop= 1.12x (0.0181 -> 0.0202 s); subret 1.10x (0.0829 -> 0.0915 s).
FASTER (> 8 %): arrfill 0.84x, boolif 0.88x, boolsum 0.92x, catmod 0.89x, catself 0.88x, collatz 0.92x, feread 0.81x, feread3 0.82x, fhprint 0.89x, fhread 0.87x, hashcopy 0.92x, joinarr 0.92x, moo-objs 0.84x, ovlsub 0.84x, pack 0.79x, packunpk 0.82x, pushloc 0.90x, regexg 0.88x, shiftq 0.89x, sliceasgn 0.76x, slices 0.90x, sortnum 0.81x, sortstr 0.89x, splice0 0.85x, strcat 0.83x, symref 0.87x, tiehash 0.90x, unshiftq 0.87x.
Within 8 %: the rest of the 67 rows (see the compare file).

READING: the faster rows are the quiet box plus s521b's deletion of the runtime `\Q` pass and s520a/s521 runtime work; the three SLOWER rows are small in absolute terms (0.02-0.09 s) and are sub-call / tight-loop rows -- candidates: s521d's `p-anon-sub` wrap (anon subs only -- gcdret / subret use NAMED subs, so probably not), s520a's `p-class-invocant` (class calls only), the `$.` slot (`%p-dot-get` is not on these paths), or noise.  Per the perf rules (docs/speed-review-s509.md; CLAUDE.md brief rule: a mover of 8-16 % gets the DUMMY-DEFUN test): (1) re-run the three rows alone twice (`perl tools/bench-exec.pl gcdret subret intloop=`) on the same tree to read the noise band; (2) A/B the RUNTIME with `BENCH_RT_B=<the fca3593b extraction's cl/pcl-runtime.lisp>` (MAIN-READY-28's runtime; ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/review/base-fca3593b) to separate runtime from emission; (3) if real, bisect the merge range by extraction.  A real > 8 % loss on a sub-call row is a Target-A regression and gets its own fix task; noise closes this one with the measurement.  Perf round 48's first item (USER s515: one perf agent every second or third session).
subject: PERF (measure first): the s521 round bench on MAIN-READY-36 vs the MAIN-READY-26 run -- 5 rows read SLOWER by more than 8 % (arrhash-k 1.10x, cfor 1.09x, gcdret 1.17x, intloop= 1.12x, subret 1.10x) while 28 of 67 rows read faster; the dummy-defun test and an A/B with BENCH_RT_B decide whether the three are real -- perf round 48's first item
